text:
ellie: quick design pass: trying to make streaming chat less jumpy. main asks: reduce token-counter noise, stop vs pause affordance, and how prompt library behaves when stream active. keep it light.
ravi: cool. token counter: what about 300ms debounce + only animate when change >=6 tokens?
ellie: i like 300ms but make threshold 6. also add a compact collapsed state that shows •• until hover.
kat: stop behaviour: single-click stop on desktop, long-press to pause on mobile. show a small tooltip first-time: ‘Hold to pause on touch’.
devops-bot: note: mobile touch target must be >=44px for accessibility.
aria-bot: visual spec v2.4 uploaded: https://figma.internal/redwood/playground/streaming/v2.4 (review by @ellie)
ellie: prompt-library insert rules: if stream active, show toast “Insert after current response” with action “Queue insert”. queued item appears as inline composer chip: “Queued: <title>” with cancel. editable before insertion.
ravi: if user edits queued item, apply edit when inserted and surface undo snackbar after insert.
kat: a11y: queued chip must be tabbable, role=status, announce changes politely. screen reader copy: “Prompt queued: <title>”.
ellie: regen is hidden while streaming. after stream finish regen appears as small button with aria-label “Regenerate response”.
kat: keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+K to queue/insert when focused in library; Shift+Space to pause/resume. document in help.
ellie: mobile: queue chip should collapse to “Queued (1)” to save space. ensure cancel is accessible.
aria-bot: acceptance checklist created in ticket: debounce=300ms, threshold=6, hold-to-pause guidance, queued-chip patterns, keyboard shortcuts, mobile responsive collapsed state.
ellie: thanks all — will update PR and ping for a quick pass :sparkles:
